# Breadcrumb

Shows where a page sits, and lets people step back up.

`AleemDesignSystem_3de1ed.Breadcrumb` · Navigation

## Use

```jsx
<AleemDesignSystem_3de1ed.Breadcrumb />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="AleemDesignSystem_3de1ed.Breadcrumb"></x-import>
```

## Notes

Where this page sits; the last item is the current page.

## Props (BreadcrumbProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | `Array<{ label: React.ReactNode; href?: string }>` | The trail, root first. The last item is the current page and needs no href. |
| `maxItems` | `number` | Longer trails collapse the middle. @default 4 |
| `label` | `string` | @default "Breadcrumb" |

_Also accepts: React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLElement>._
